errors.error_description: Introduced an unintentional latch by omitting a complete assignment to rsp_valid_d in the always_comb state logic; in the S_SETUP state, rsp_valid_d is only assigned for reads and not for writes.
Assigned a 16-bit signal (rsp_rdata_q) to an 8-bit output (dbg_status_o) without explicit truncation, causing silent data truncation.
